description: Fresh installed regressions after recursive CPAN integration. All original receipts retain their recorded identities. Shared C/C++/Rust/Python/Ruby/JVM public projections and installed behavior are compared with their original packages. Ruby retains its original declared glibc 2.38 floor so its archive and installed-file comparison is exact. Existing Perl APIs use newly built native/runtime archives and preserve their original public observations. Fault coverage retains the Array snapshot checkpoints introduced by commit 5da8a7b: three for Compound and List fixtures, sixteen for Alias fixtures and seven for Variant fixtures. The reviewed Compound source tree reconstructs the earlier named-Deep alias change from commit 00e6380. Declaration listing order is normalized by name; parameter, result and field order remain exact.
